corrected_verdict: PARTIALLY_KNOWN (the template is Morwani App. F.1; the ReLU 1-Lipschitz extension was not found in the ML literature). The printed constant is wrong for n>=2: the correct bound is C_2 <= 1/(2p), not p^{-n}/2.
issues: Verdict and both confirmed citations survive. Morwani 2311.07568 App. F.1 has the Plancherel and Cauchy-Schwarz steps and the line 'shifting the mean of w does not affect the margin'. Gromov 2301.02679 has the ReLU remark, and its App. B says 'We do not have an analytic proof'. No ML paper bounds a ReLU single-neuron Fourier/margin budget. Checked: 2511.23443 (Huang & Li, ReLU vs sine, expressivity only), 2606.05863 (Tan et al., locally-linear reduction only), 2407.12332 (Mohamadi et al., l_inf margin, quadratic net), 2402.09469 (Li et al., power activations only), 2412.03773 (ReLU MLP mechanistic bounds), 2608.04451 (dynamics only). Checker errors: (1) the j=0 issue is a false alarm, since prelim.tex l.7 defines \Fp={1,...,(p-1)/2}, so recommended change (2) is unnecessary. (2) The checker missed a real error in appendix.tex l.283. The stated steps give sum_{j in F}|h^(j..j) w^(j)| <= (p^n/4)||omega||^2, not (p/4)||omega||^2, so C_2 <= 1/(2p) (= B_p at nu=2), not p^{-n}/2. A numerical check (items/t13-relu-budget/relu_budget_check.py) finds random ReLU neurons with C_2 >= 0.00391 at p=23, n=2, against the claimed 0.000945, with violations also at p=7 and 11 and at n=3. The conclusion (Thm universal and Cor dense apply at b=nu=2) survives with the corrected constant.
